# Sejong Center Renewal / 세종문화회관 리뉴얼

> Active application: v5. Next.js 14 App Router, React 18, TypeScript, Node.js 24. Supabase for authentication and data; Vercel for static hosting.

## Mandatory collaboration rule / 브랜치 필수

All humans and models MUST edit on task branches. Use separate worktrees or clones for concurrent work. Main is integration-only. Merge reviewed branches with --no-ff; use normal pushes. Preserve history and existing work.

사람과 모든 모델은 작업 브랜치를 반드시 사용하며 검토 후 main에 --no-ff로 통합합니다. 이전 main 직접 수정 규칙은 대체되었습니다.

## Commit convention

`**<branch>** English type: Korean description` (Always wrap current branch name in double asterisks at the very beginning). Commit and push the task branch; integrate reviewed work into main with --no-ff. Do not treat a push as proof of deployment.
